title: Audio Model Conversions
summary: This module provides utilities to convert various audio, speech, and music generation model checkpoints from their original formats to Hugging Face Transformers format, ensuring compatibility and ease of use.

nodes.label: Convert Audio Models
nodes.title: Audio Model Conversion
nodes.description: Converts general audio processing models from various frameworks to Hugging Face Transformers format, handling diverse architectures and weights.

nodes.label: Convert Speech-to-Text Models
nodes.title: Speech-to-Text Conversion
nodes.description: Facilitates the conversion of speech-to-text and speech processing models, including sequence-to-sequence and CTC architectures, into the Hugging Face ecosystem.

nodes.label: Convert Music Generation Models
nodes.title: Music Generation Conversion
nodes.description: Handles the specialized conversion process for music generation models, integrating their unique components and configurations into the Hugging Face format.

nodes.label: Convert SeamlessM4T Models
nodes.title: SeamlessM4T Model Conversion
nodes.description: Dedicated conversion utilities for SeamlessM4T and SeamlessM4Tv2 models, managing their complex multi-modal architectures and distinct components.

nodes.label: Convert NeMo Framework Models
nodes.title: NeMo Framework Conversion
nodes.description: Converts models originally developed within the NVIDIA NeMo framework to be compatible with Hugging Face Transformers.

groups.label: General Audio Models
groups.title: General Audio Model Converters
groups.description: Tools for converting a wide array of general-purpose audio models and their associated processing components.

groups.label: Speech-Specific Models
groups.title: Speech-Specific Model Converters
groups.description: Specialized converters for models designed for speech recognition, synthesis, and translation tasks.
